c: See how we’ve helped homeowners refresh their outdoor spaces with fast, professional patio furniture removal. From cluttered patios to clean, inviting areas, we handle the heavy lifting so you can enjoy your space again.

items.q: 1. What types of patio furniture do you remove?
a: We remove all types, including dining sets, loungers, sectionals, fire pits, and accessories. Whether it’s metal, wicker, wood, or plastic, our team handles everything from single pieces to complete outdoor sets.

items.q: 2. Do you take old grills, umbrellas, or outdoor décor?
a: Yes! We remove grills (propane tanks removed), umbrellas, cushions, planters, and all outdoor décor. Just point to what needs to go, and we’ll handle it.

items.q: 3. Can you disassemble my patio furniture before removal?
a: Absolutely. Our team will safely disassemble large or complex pieces like sectional sofas, pergolas, or swing sets at no extra cost.

items.q: 4. How much does patio furniture removal cost?
a: Our pricing depends on the quantity and type of furniture being removed. We offer free, no-obligation quotes to provide accurate pricing for your specific items.

items.q: 5. What areas do you serve for patio furniture removal?
a: We cover all of Edmonton, including Downtown, North/South/West Edmonton, St. Albert, and surrounding areas. Call to confirm your location.
